name: Awaji Reiko
source:
She is a student in the protagonist's class, but unlike Sumire, she is in a position to torment him. Although she has the title of leader of the “student council,” in reality, she controls and encourages students to engage in compensated dating for the purpose of getting a cut of the profits.

The number of teachers who have been kicked out of school for doing anything that displeases her has already reached double digits. She is a picture-perfect young lady and has been selfish all her life. 

Her hobby is swimming, but she likes feeling the eyes of those who are glued to her body more than swimming itself. She is a girl who is thrilled about the protagonist's good looks.
